dedupe_keys.name: global tropical and subtropical wetlands map v3 swamp

description: The Global Tropical and Subtropical Wetlands Map, version 3, maps wetland and peatland extent and peat depth across the tropics and subtropics from 40 degrees north to 60 degrees south, excluding small islands. It is produced by the Center for International Forestry Research under its Sustainable Wetlands Adaptation and Mitigation Program with a hydro-geomorphological expert-system model (Gumbricht et al. 2017) based on long-term water supply, waterlogged soils and geomorphological position, and version 3 adds generalisation to remove isolated pixels and smooth edges. Resolution is about 236 m, as a single static map. Format and access: GeoTIFF download at original resolution plus an ArcGIS layer file, through a web map where users can also submit wetland information; download needs a guest book entry and acceptance of the terms of use but no login. Licence: CIFOR terms of use requiring citation, provided as is; free. Caveats: it is a model estimate, not a survey, and the page stresses uncertainty about wetland extent and variability in the tropics. It supports climate adaptation and flood-regulation studies that treat wetlands as blue infrastructure. A related catalogue record is the Global Lakes and Wetlands Database v2, which covers the whole globe with different classes.
